PREP Station: Genkotsu Split, Chashu Roll & Vegetable Pre-Cut Field Guide

Prep speed sets your rush-hour buffer. Stock 10+2 portions pre-shift. Split bones, cold-soak 30min, skim blood foam — skip this and tonkotsu smells off by hour two.

⌨ L-click mash split / Shift+chop scallions batch

⚡ Split → soak → slice chashu → peel ajitama (120s chain)

SIMMER Station: Kombu 60°C · Genkotsu 95°C · Hold Pot 86–92°C Control

Umami synergy = glutamate × inosinate. Below 85°C fat separates; Brix 8.5–11.2° is the golden band. This stage sets ~80% of your score.

⌨ Fine-tune temp slider / low flame ±1°C hold

⚡ Kombu 60°C → bone 95°C → skim → 88°C hold

COOK Station: Barikata 15s · Futsu 30s · Double Basket Shake

Double snap the basket — noodle water dilutes broth fast. Boiler above 98°C. Serve below 86°C and critics dock stars.

⌨ Auto timer on drop / double shake -92% water

⚡ Drop → 15s → double shake → pass to BUILD (<28s)

BUILD Station: 15ml Tare · Mayu Last · Physics Plating

Plating balance hits visual critic scores. Black garlic mayu goes last. 15ml tare in bowl bottom — never dump into the stockpot.

⌨ Drag physics placement / mayu click last

⚡ Tare 15ml → ladle → noodles → toppings → mayu (18s)

SERVE Station: 7:3 Draft Beer · Hanetsuki Gyoza · Broth Temp Hold

Every 5s on the pass cools soup 1°C. 7:3 foam line = +18% tip bonus. Hold foam 8s post-pour for Perfect Serve.

⌨ Hit 7:3 line / triple sprint delivery

⚡ Beer 7:3 → flip gyoza → sprint ramen (12s triple)

RESET Station: Dishwash · Shuriken · Extinguisher

Dishwashing is the #1 co-op bottleneck (22% fail rate). Bell rings, shuriken flies. Grease fire = extinguisher only.

⌨ Mash dishwash speed / bell → instant shuriken

⚡ Collect → wash → dry → reuse (35s/5 bowls)

BROTH UMAMI FORMULA LAB

Japanese Ramen Simulator Broth Umami Formula: Synergy Theory & Temperature Equation

Umami Score = (Glu[Kombu] × Ino[Genkotsu/Katsuobushi])^0.72 × USM × Emulsion(T)

USM (Umami Synergy Multiplier) = 1.0 + 0.15×min(Glu,Ino)/100. Both Glu+Ino above 90 → USM=1.35. Emulsion(T) = 1.0 (86–92°C) / 0.62 (<85°C) / 0.88 (>95°C)

BRIX Brix 8.5–11.2° balances umami, aroma, and cost. 7h tonkotsu +2.1° Brix; kombu 60°C 60min +0.8°.

COLLAGEN Collagen hydrolysis curve: 95°C×4h → 80% gelatinization → +12 emulsion. 100°C 48h+ → fat cap → Aroma -15.

Kombu glutamate and genkotsu/katsuobushi inosinate multiply — not add. Drop below 85°C and Emulsion falls to 0.62, critic stars fall together. Tune all three variables in the Broth Builder.

Japanese Ramen Simulator Broth Umami Formula: Ratio Theory & Live Calc Guide

Stock:Tare:Fat Golden Ratio & Umami Synergy Multiplier (USM)

60–70% stock, 15–20% tare, 10–15% fat emulsion is the synergy sweet spot. USM = 1.0 + 0.15×min(Glu,Ino)/100. Both Glu+Ino above 90 → USM=1.35.

  • ▸7h tonkotsu: Brix +2.1° / +12 emulsion / 80% collagen gelatinized (95°C×4h)
  • ▸Kombu 60°C 60min: Glu +22 / Brix +0.8° / 100°C 48h+ fat cap → Aroma -15
  • ▸15ml tare in bowl bottom — dumping into stockpot costs Emulsion -0.18
  • ▸Hold 86–92°C: Emulsion(T)=1.0 / <85°C=0.62 / >95°C=0.88
  • ▸Calculator workflow: ① pick stock ② tare ③ noodle ④ temp slider → live Umami/Aroma/ROI

Full Umami Score Formula & ROI Margin

Umami = (Glu × Ino)^0.72 × USM × Emulsion(T) | ROI% = ((Price−Cost)÷Cost)×100

Suggested price = round(cost×3.2/10)×10. Example: ¥380→¥1,220→+221% ROI. Below 80°C: Umami -8, Aroma -12. Export PNG poster for the kitchen wall.

86–92°C Holding Pot Emulsion Maintenance Mechanism

  • ★86–92°C: gelatin keeps fat in suspension — Emulsion=1.0
  • ★<85°C: fat separates → emulsion breaks → Aroma -22 → critic -2★
  • ★88°C hold: batch 2×100L pre-open → valid 48h (spoils at 72h)
  • ★100°C boil: over-emulsified → fat cap → rest 10s before service
  • ★Temp slider: drag 60–100°C to watch Emulsion factor update live

Japanese Ramen Simulator New Game Walkthrough: Days 1–3 Shop Expansion Guide

Day 1 · Target ¥12,000

One menu item (black garlic tonkotsu + Barikata). Prep ten portions. Buy ¥12,000 holding pot first. Skip ¥80,000 decor — cash below ¥25,000 = Day 4 bankruptcy. Waste target <8%.

Day 2 · Target ¥15,000

Memorize Tanaka's sheet, land one 5★ (+¥50,000 tip). Practice 7:3 beer off-peak. Next buy: boil timer ¥8,500.

Day 3 · Target ¥18,000 (¥45,000 cumulative)

Two-player split PREP+SIMMER / COOK+BUILD. Buy dishwasher speed ¥15,000. RESET bottleneck sets revenue ceiling. Week 1 end: 2 critics at 5★ + ¥60,000 cash.

⚠ Bankruptcy warning: spending ¥40,000+ on decor/BGM/premium dishware Days 1–3 means Day 4 supply shortage Game Over. Broth temp and dishwash first — decor after Day 10.

FAQ KNOWLEDGE BASE

Japanese Ramen Simulator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Top 13 community questions pre-Steam 2026 — co-op reconnect, broth spoilage, critic fallback, beer foam retention included. Updated after every patch.

Q1.When is Japanese Ramen Simulator releasing on Steam?

Developed by Tokyo studio Wild Dog. The game was scheduled for Steam Early Access on September 28, 2026 at 9:00 AM JST but did not launch — the publisher cites a delay in Steam's pre-release review process, and a new date is not yet announced (TBA). Delay confirmed Sept 28; App ID: 4968640. Supports solo play through 6-player online co-op on the same shop save.

Q2.How do you push umami and aroma scores into the 90s?

Hold genkotsu at 95–100°C, kombu at 60°C, katsuobushi dashi on spec, and lock the holding pot at 86–92°C. Glutamate × inosinate drives umami; Brix 8.5–11.2° is the sweet spot. Below 85°C the emulsion breaks and aroma collapses.

Q3.What does it take to score 5 stars from food critics?

Match each critic's exact broth, tare, and noodle firmness (Tanaka = rich tonkotsu + black mayu + Barikata). Serve at ≥86°C within the 90s/120s countdown. Below 82°C costs stars.

Q4.Which station bottlenecks 6-player co-op the hardest?

The dishwash station (RESET). At full six-player roster, runners rotate to dishwash the moment the pass clears. Prepping 10 portions of chashu + ajitama before open cuts peak-hour gridlock in half.

Q5.What is the 7:3 draft beer ratio and does it affect profit?

Seven parts liquid, three parts foam — the golden line. Miss it and tip bonus drops. Hold the 7:3 foam ratio for 8s post-pour to trigger Perfect Serve. Ramen + beer + gyoza combo pushes ticket average fastest.

Q6.Day 1–3 cash crunch: what upgrades first?

① Better holding pot insulation → ② Accurate boil timers → ③ Faster dishwasher cycle. Decor can wait. Day 1 revenue target ¥12,000; ¥45,000 cumulative by Day 3 is the safety line.

Q7.How do you handle thieves and grease fires?

Register bell = shuriken immediately. Grease fire = extinguisher only, never water. Don't let the holding pot drop while firefighting — cold soup tanks that day's critic scores.

Q8.What happens when the host disconnects mid co-op?

Auto-reconnect within 30s. Full disconnect freezes kitchen state (broth temp, active noodle timers). After reconnect, clear RESET backlog before resuming. Three consecutive drops end the session — pre-prep 10 portions for faster recovery.

Q9.How do you fix spoiled / sour broth?

HUD flashes "Broth Spoilage" — reheat to 88°C for 30s on low flame. If the pH indicator turns red, dump the entire batch (reusing costs -3 critic stars). Prevent with 86–92°C holding and airtight lid at close.

Q10.Surprise critic visit — what's the fallback play?

Watch for omens (bell chime, sakura particles, ROI graph) and switch to the fallback build immediately. Tanaka = tonkotsu + mayu + Barikata 15s. Sayuri = paitan + yuzu salt + Futsu 30s. Priority: temp > plating > topping count for minimum 3★.

Q11.Draft beer foam collapses too fast — why?

Tap temp > 6°C makes coarse foam. Grease on the glass kills head retention in 30s. Fix: install tap chiller, cold-rinse glasses, rest 8s after hitting the 7:3 line. Perfect Serve requires 8s foam hold.

Q12.How do you control ingredient waste?

"10 portions + 2 backup" at PREP is the golden ratio. Bone stock loses 15% umami at 48h, spoils at 72h. Tare goes in the bowl bottom at 15ml — never dump into the stockpot.

Q13.Why does buying luxury decor early cause bankruptcy?

Day 1–3 ticket average is fixed at ¥980 — decor bonuses only affect affluent customers after Day 10. ¥80,000 counter vs ¥12,000 holding pot: the pot gives +3°C broth temp today. Buying decor with < ¥25,000 cash = Day 4 supply shortage Game Over.
